assay: bulk mRNA-seq of rat left-ventricular myocardium, Illumina NovaSeq 6000, HISAT2 + featureCounts (S2.15.p1)

group: HF + treadmill exercise (60 min/day, 5 d/wk, 8 wk, 50-60% max)

sample_inclusion: n = 3 per group in GEO (12 samples); Fig 5A states n = 3 for BAIBA vs HF
tissue_note: anterior LV wall; in the BAIBA group the peri-infarct area was used (S2.15.p1)
primary_estimand: Effect of treadmill exercise on the myocardial transcriptome of rats with post-MI heart failure: HF+Exercise vs HF+Sedentary (abstract ABS.p3 compares 'exercised' with 'Sham (non-exercised) HF'). The paper's only reported RNA-seq DEG result is the exercise-mimetic BAIBA arm vs non-exercised HF (S3.4.p1, Fig 5).
planned_contrasts: HF+Exercise vs HF+Sedentary (exercise effect; paper's estimand for exercise, ABS.p3 / S3.1-S3.2; no RNA-seq DEG count reported)

HF+BAIBA vs HF+Sedentary (S3.4.p1, Fig 5A-C: 11 up, 18 down = 29 DEGs; text says 'compared to the Sham group' but Fig 5A says 'BAIBA vs. HF group' and the paper calls the non-exercised HF group 'Sham (non-exercised) HF' in ABS.p3)

paper_threshold_alternative.source_locator: S3.4.p1 (FC > 2.0, P < 0.05, stated with the 11/18 counts)

paper_method: DESeq2 (in-house pipeline, Shanghai Applied Protein Technology), two-group comparisons (S2.15.p1)
